about: L18 gold set: questions about the L1-L17 notes, each with the note sections that answer it. A chunk is relevant if its id equals, or is a continuation (-2, -3, ...) of, a listed id. 'kind' says which retriever the question was written to favour: identifier (exact tokens; keyword search), paraphrase (different words for the same idea; embeddings), near-duplicate (two lectures cover close topics; reranking), out-of-corpus (the notes do not answer it; the abstention gate). Written by hand on 2026-10-11 from the section list of notes-l01-l17.json.
